s0.ru: Лифт начинает с этажа {start}. Остановки по порядку, всего {n}: {listing}. К каждой он едет сразу, путь — модуль разности этажей. Каков весь путь?
s0.en: The elevator starts at floor {start}. Stops in order, {n} in total: {listing}. It goes straight to each one, and the path is the absolute difference of the floors. What is the whole path?

s1.en: The elevator starts at floor {start}. Stops in order, {n} in total: {listing}. It goes straight to each one. On which floor does it stop at the end?
